# Dist media · lean but engaging

**Law (Blaze 2026-09-14):** Imagery (and short vids) are critical to grow `@0xRayAI`. Stay **on brand**. Do **not** burn compute regenerating what the kit already has.

## Order of operations (every post / film)
1. **Reuse** from `ops/dist/brand/` (suits · diagrams · mark · POST-001) or repo `xray/scripts/media/`
2. **Crop / caption / recombine** existing stills (cheap) before any new gen
3. **Generate** only if no kit asset fits the one idea (lane A/B/C prompt templates)
4. **Film** only for how-tos / proof loops (hangar pay, suit fasten) — script first, short, reuse stills as B-roll

## Compute tiers
| Tier | When | Cost bar |
|------|------|----------|
| **L0 reuse** | Default weekday Dist | $0 gen — pick kit file |
| **L1 light gen** | New diagram / stamp map missing | 1 image, 16:9, lane A/C |
| **L2 hero** | Major ship / identity beat | 1 suit still — prefer Blaze pack over regen |
| **L3 film** | How-to / receipt proof | ≤60s; storyboard ≤5 shots; no thrash regenerates |

**Cap:** ≤1 new gen asset per Dist post unless Blaze says otherwise. Never batch-regen “options.”

## Must have engaging media when
- Teaching a new concept (suit · mill · hangar · stamp board)
- Shipping / live infra proof
- Growth threads meant to stop the scroll

## Skip / thin media when
- Pure reply in a live @grok thread (text OK unless asked)
- FYI ack / URL-only verify
- Duplicate of yesterday’s diagram with no new idea

## Brand
Follow `BRAND-IMAGES.md` + `STAMPS.md` + `PROMPT-TEMPLATE.md`. Friend-test every asset. No off-brand photoreal faces. No watermark soup.

## Kit inventory (start here)
- `suits/` · exo heroes (Blaze + exo-v4 plates)
- `diagrams/ecosystem-full-stack.png` · stack map
- `diagrams/ecosystem-base-layers.png` · prior map
- `post-001-reference.png` · agent→suit→mill
- `profile.jpg` / `logo.jpg` · mark only
